issues.legal_issue: Whether concurrent findings of ownership and encroachment warrant interference in an appeal under Article 136 of the Constitution in the absence of a valid ground.
Whether an encroacher who has not established that they are a transferee acting under a bona fide defective title may claim the protections of Section 51 of the Transfer of Property Act.

Whether the landowner’s conduct amounted to acquiescence or estoppel barring recovery of possession of encroached land where the owner objected to the construction and sued within the limitation period.
Whether compensation may be awarded instead of demolition and recovery of possession when the landowner establishes title and the opposing party has encroached on the land.
